stem: Meena's mother compares two packaged snacks for a school tiffin. Each label gives values per 100 g. Junk foods are high in calories and fat but low in protein and dietary fibre. Which snack better fits the junk-food pattern?

options.text: Baked soya sticks: 380 kcal, 8 g fat, 20 g protein, 12 g dietary fibre
Fried banana chips: 540 kcal, 32 g fat, 6 g protein, 5 g dietary fibre
Roasted peanuts: 400 kcal, 14 g fat, 24 g protein, 9 g dietary fibre
Sprouted moong mix: 330 kcal, 5 g fat, 19 g protein, 15 g dietary fibre

teacher.key_rationale: Option B has the highest calories (540 kcal) and fat (32 g) together with the lowest protein (6 g) and dietary fibre (5 g), so it matches the junk-food pattern most strongly; the other options are lower in fat and calories and richer in protein and fibre.
